detail: Case is layer functional with precondition 'Ordering.API is running in OrderingApiFixture'; the test runs as a Playwright API request against the test-stack Ordering.API instead. Steps and assertions match exactly and the real running service is used, so this is minor, but plan and test now disagree on layer.

Case is layer functional with the fixture's built-in sign-in as precondition; the test runs on the test stack and gets a real token by signing alice in through the orderingswaggerui implicit flow. Body, status, media type, status/detail/title assertions all match the case; only the layer and identity mechanism differ.

The case is layer: functional with the precondition 'Ordering.API is running in the functional fixture (OrderingApiFixture)', and the plan index lists e2e as out of scope. The test runs as a Playwright request test against the test stack instead. The steps and assertions match the case, so this is a divergence from the plan, not a weaker test. Either move the test into OrderDraftContractTests or have the plan state the test-stack layer.

The case is layer: functional with the precondition that OrderingApiFixture authenticates every request. The test runs on the test stack with an implicit-flow token for alice. Every expected result is asserted exactly (400, application/problem+json, status 400, the detail text, a non-empty title), but the layer differs from the plan's.
